title: Design: the Quick Add row and its sell price filling in
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1).
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Add Part under line 1.
  3. Pick category A in Category.
  4. Type 100.00 in Cost.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • One row opens under the line with boxes Part number, Description *, Qty *, Category, Cost and Sell price, and Save, Cancel and More Options under them, as in picture 10.6.

Step 3:

  • Category reads category A.

Step 4:

  • Sell price fills in with 121.50.
  • No Priced by text or Manual icon shows in the row.
  • The Save button is blue.
